151681.title: Adriaan van der Hoop’s Trotter ‘De Vlugge’ (The Fast One) in a Meadow
151681.creator: Anthony Oberman

editorial.note: Upper-class Dutchmen aspired to the life of an English gentleman. The fabulously rich banker and art collector Adriaan van der Hoop owned racehorses and, like members of the English aristocracy, had portraits made of his prizewinners.

Willem Maris may have used this small painting as a preparatory study for several of his large compositions with a cow. From the cow’s contours, it is clear that it was painted in light colours over a dark brown ground.
